title: Best of Downtown Nashville!
description:
In the center of everything downtown, parking pass included.  Walk to Broadway, Second Ave, the Convention Center, Bridgestone Arena, Printers Alley, the Gulch, TN State Capitol, and the Bicentennial Mall. You'll love the brand-new stylish furniture, luxurious amenities, and the convenient location. You'll be greeted with Keurig coffee and high-end tea in a stylish condo. Traveling with a larger group? We have another unit in this building! Ask about our 1-bedroom unit for 4.

The space
This Airbnb is managed by a team with over 40 years experience in the hospitality and philanthropic industry. It's a super clean condo cleaned with safe and natural cleaning products. The condo is located on a quiet street, but close to everything in downtown. Enjoy!

Guest access
You'll have the entire condo and the city of Nashville to enjoy!

Other things to note
-Free Parking!
